server.description: DX Web API base URL. The token comes from DX_API_TOKEN, never from the manifest.

cache.description: Where the last snapshot was written, repo-relative. An offline run replays it and verifies its digest.

defaultContext.description: Context used for DX identifiers that do not already have Portolan's context.service shape.

entityTypes.description: DX entity types imported as Portolan services.

relations.description: DX relation identifiers imported as generic service dependencies.

technologyProperty.description: DX property identifier whose string or string-list value contains technologies.

kindProperty.description: DX property identifier whose value is a Portolan component kind.
